      "login": "tumutech",

    },
    {
      "login": "fametrano",

    },
    {
      "login": "musaHaruna",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "concerned that removing expiry could retain unminable high-feerate transactions that displace minable ones under memory pressure; suggests deprecation"

      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "clarified that they only spot-checked a few time-evicted transactions and suggested someone verify in full"

    {
      "login": "fanquake",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "suggested minor wording improvement for release notes"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:6206090292",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "removing expiry entirely prevents node operators and miners from reverting to previous default behavior if the change turns out harmful",
      "quote": "I don't think it's a good idea to change the node's behaviour in a way that doesn't allow users/miners to revert to the previous default in case the change turns out to be undesirable or harmful for s",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied arguing that reasons to keep expiry are thin, adversarial cycling makes it ineffective, and expiry creates privacy leaks on rebroadcast",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6605091861"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:6216612525"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6605091861",
      "status_by_quote": "I think the reasons mentioned above by you and @ajtowns are thin. ... So it would be more ideal to just clean this code "
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6206090292",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "phase in the change by setting DEFAULT_MEMPOOL_EXPIRY_HOURS to a large value (e.g. 4 years) rather than removing it entirely",
      "quote": "Is there any reason why this change shouldn't be phased in via setting `DEFAULT_MEMPOOL_EXPIRY_HOURS` to a large value, such as 35040 (4 years), instead?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author declined phasing in via DEFAULT_MEMPOOL_EXPIRY_HOURS citing censorship concerns",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6605091861"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:6216612525"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6605091861",
      "status_by_quote": "There is a legitimate concern raised by @mzumsande, and offline by a few other people, that this approach also aids cens"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4297923468",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "whether MallocUsage() should be updated to account for 6 pointers now that entry_time index is removed",
      "quote": "would it be fine to use 6 in MallocUsage() so that the same -maxmempool budget can hold extra txn you talked about in the nice side-effect?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author confirmed MallocUsage() has been updated in the latest push",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4455310210"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4455310210",
      "status_by_quote": "Fixed, thanks."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6394943202",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "wallet_resendwallettransactions.py no longer verifies that a parent transaction is resubmitted before its child",
      "quote": "wallet_resendwallettransactions.py no longer checks that a parent is resubmitted before its child.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6394943202",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "update DynamicMemoryUsage() to use 6 pointers per entry or drop the claim from the PR description",
      "quote": "Could this PR use 6 pointers, as tumutech suggests, or drop the \"fits slightly more transactions\" sentence?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "fixed in push confirmed in rc:4455310210 updating MallocUsage() to use 6 pointers",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4455310210",
      "status_by_quote": "Fixed, thanks."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6394943202",
      "part": 3,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "document in the release notes that abandontransaction now fails for transactions older than two weeks",
      "quote": "One change may deserve a line in the note: `abandontransaction` on a wallet transaction older than two weeks now fails with \"Transaction not eligible for abandonment\".",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5667388831",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Removing expiry entirely could cause outdated nodes to retain high-feerate transactions rejected by miners, displacing minable transactions under memory pressure and raising the minimum mempool feerate.",
      "quote": "Under memory pressure, they could displace lower-feerate transactions that miners would actually include, potentially causing more `SIZELIMIT` removals and raising the minimum mempool feerate.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that expiry does not prevent rebroadcast cycles, fee estimator defaults are not affected, and outdated nodes should update",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6605091861"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6605091861",
      "status_by_quote": "The best thing to do in this case is to update the node, because expiry doesn't help here either."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5667388831",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Deprecate `-mempoolexpiry` with age expiry disabled by default rather than removing its functionality immediately.",
      "quote": "I'm leaning toward deprecating `-mempoolexpiry` rather than removing its functionality immediately, with age expiry disabled by default but still available explicitly during the deprecation period.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author declined deprecation, arguing immediate removal is cleaner and avoids incentives for free relay",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6605091861"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6605091861",
      "status_by_quote": "So it would be more ideal to just clean this code up and remove this feature, it is unnecessary."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5667388831",
      "part": 3,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Whether there is existing evidence that the protection expiry provides against persistent policy disagreement is negligible enough to justify removing the mechanism entirely, rather than just changing the default.",
      "quote": "Is there already evidence that the protection expiry provides against persistent policy disagreement is negligible enough to justify removing the mechanism entirely, rather than just changing the defa",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that observing such transactions being mined demonstrates incentive compatibility",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6605091861"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6605091861",
      "status_by_quote": "I think the fact that it is possible, and that we see such transactions mined, should suffice."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:6216612525",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "operators should assume mempool usage up to -maxmempool, historical reasons for expiry no longer hold, and immediate cleanup is beneficial",
      "substantive": true,

      "reason": "",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Added fanquake with neutral stance for a minor editorial suggestion on release notes wording. The PR remains waiting on the author to respond to fametrano's objection regarding wallet test coverage.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "addressing fametrano's objection regarding lost test coverage in wallet_resendwallettransactions.py",
      "id": "c:6394943202"
    }
  ]
}
